name: Tada Hitoshi
source: A high school student who is in the same class as Serizawa Aya. He has a strong body and very good movements. Hitoshi is the hope of the school's track club and sometimes got to compete in the national tournament. He has a rather playful personality. Because of his athletic ability, he was sent to be assessed by the student health examination board alongside Serizawa Aya. There he would meet Yanase Momoe and Shimizu Yuki. On the examination day, he would see the girls in their most embarrassing moments.
